title: Ms. Rachel Is Making a Real Album — With a Cello!
summary:
Have you ever sung along with Ms. Rachel? She's the grown-up with the pink headband and the singsong voice who teaches songs and words to millions of little kids. Her real name is Rachel Accurso. Since 2019, she and her husband, Aron, have made videos on YouTube. Their channel is called "Songs for Littles." Those videos now have more than 17.2 billion views!

Here's the big news: Ms. Rachel is putting out her very first album. It's called "I'm So Happy," and it comes out on Sept. 25. The album has 23 songs. Some are brand-new. Some are favorite kids' songs and nursery rhymes. Ms. Rachel says she wants kids to hear real instruments, like a cello. She hopes a kid at home might think, "Wow, maybe I could play that!"

The couple started making videos in Ms. Rachel's parents' basement. They didn't even have a tripod. They stacked up books to hold the camera! They began because their son had trouble learning to speak, and they couldn't find the right help. So they made their own songs and lessons.

Now Ms. Rachel is everywhere — in books, on Netflix, and in toy stores. She also speaks up for kids living in wars, in places like Gaza, Ukraine, and Sudan. She says every child should have a warm, safe home and enough food. Some people criticized her for that. But she says she will keep saying it: "Let's take care of kids."
why_it_matters: If you have a younger brother, sister or cousin, you've probably seen how a simple song can teach them words — this album shows that music is one of the first ways little kids learn.
